subject: Veridex: SIG/CAIQ intake — scheduling, Q&A, and action items
messages:
From: Emma Hoover <emma.hoover@veridex.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: liam.oconnor@veridex.com
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + SIG/CAIQ intake request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — Veridex is running a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our platform due diligence. We'd like a 45-min intake call to: 1) review your CAIQ prefill, 2) walk through SOC 2 scope and controls, and 3) confirm what log/artifact samples we can get for our security team.

Availability: we can do Tue 9/15 3pm ET or Wed 9/16 10am ET.

What we'd like you to bring: CAIQ prefill (spreadsheet), SOC 2 report (redacted ok), and an example of access/log export for inference requests. Also, a short runbook describing incident escalation would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to share a short intake agenda if useful.

Emma
Security Engineering | Veridex
[Attachment: Veridex-SIG-intake-template.docx (docx)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Emma Hoover <emma.hoover@veridex.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/CAIQ intake request

Hi Emma — great to meet you virtually. Wed 9/16 10am ET works for us; locking that in (calendar invite sent). We'll plan for a focused 45-min session: 20 min CAIQ walkthrough, 15 min SOC 2 scope + logs, 10 min Q&A / next steps.

Prep we can provide before the call:
- CAIQ prefill (spreadsheet) — we'll upload a working copy
- Redacted SOC 2 report PDF
- Example log export (redacted) — sample of inference request metadata (timestamps, model version, region, request id), not payloads

Soojin will lead the controls discussion and Marissa will take notes / own artifact handoff.

Action: we'll upload the CAIQ prefill and SOC2 redacted by EOD Tuesday so your team can review. Can you confirm any specific control questions up front (e.g., data retention, key management, network isolation)?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-availability.ics (ics)]

From: Emma Hoover <emma.hoover@veridex.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridex.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/CAIQ intake request

Thanks, Kimberly — Wed 9/16 10am ET confirmed.

A couple of clarifying asks for the CAIQ review: we care most about the following control areas up front:
- Data residency & egress controls (does Redwood allow customers to restrict inference to a region / VPC?)
- Key management (KMS/HSM integrations and who holds keys)
- Audit logs & log retention (sample format and retention periods)
- Multi-tenant isolation (how do you isolate customers on Dedicated vs Hosted)

If you can flag those in the prefill, that'll speed the call. Also we require an NDA for certain artifacts; I'll send a short mutual NDA via DocuSign and loop legal if needed.

Emma
Security Engineering | Veridex

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Emma Hoover <emma.hoover@veridex.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-16T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Notes from today's SIG/CAIQ intake call (9/16/2026)

Hi Emma / Liam — thanks for the call today. Quick summary and agreed next steps below.

Meeting notes (concise):
- Attendees: Emma Hoover (Veridex), Liam O'Connor (Veridex), Kimberly Park (Redwood), Soojin Lee (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood, CS)
- Goal: CAIQ prefill walkthrough, SOC 2 scoping, sample artifacts for Veridex security review.

Key Q&A highlights:
- Data residency: Hosted API routes can be pinned to region-level endpoints; Dedicated and Private (VPC) deployments enable strict region enforcement. Customer can select region at deployment time.
- Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and an HSM-based provider for Private installs; hosted customers can opt for Redwood-managed keys but can also bring-your-own (BYOK) with limited ops overhead.
- Audit logs: we provided a sample schema showing request_id, model, model_version, timestamp, client_id, region, latency_ms, and policy_flags. Retention default 90 days for hosted; Dedicated/Private can configure longer retention.
- Multi-tenant isolation: hosted uses strict logical tenancy with workload-aware routing; Dedicated provides GPU pool isolation; Private is customer-owned infrastructure. We reviewed fallback policies and can show tenancy diagrams on follow-up.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Redwood to upload CAIQ prefill (workbook) and redacted SOC 2 report — Owner: kimberly_park — ETA: 2026-09-16 EOD — Attachment: CAIQ-veridex-v1.xlsx, SOC2-Redwood-redacted.pdf
2) Redwood to export a sanitized log sample (tar.gz) with timestamps and request metadata — Owner: marissa_cole — ETA: 2026-09-17 EOD — Attachment: veridex_log_sample.tar.gz
3) Veridex to review CAIQ prefill and send control-specific follow-ups by 2026-09-24 — Owner: Emma Hoover
4) Schedule technical deep-dive on network isolation (if requested) — Owner: soojin_lee / Veridex security — ETA: TBD

Follow-up notes: we flagged one SOC 2 scope ask around third-party vendors used for observability (we will provide a vendor list). Also noted Veridex may request an exec summary of SLAs for Dedicated.

If anything above needs correction, tell us and we'll update.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: meeting-recording-link (recording)]
